label: batch-56
tail:
Batch 56 authoring is complete. The draft carriers were already present, so I audited them and corrected the perfect-fluid comparison to separate formal coefficient cases from its positive-response assumptions, and made the bulk linearization’s zero-pressure rest state explicit. The A/B pages, manifest, contracts, source evidence, and readiness records are consistent.

- Scoped checks passed: precheck (5/5), proof-layout (20 steps, 0 defects), proof contracts (5/5), rendercheck (7 files), selected physics check, focused dependency check, content policy, and source fetch (6/6).
- Computed item levels match the manifests: 0, 3, 3, 4, 5. Batch 56 remains level 2 with prerequisites 53 and 55.
- Readiness is `ready` for `lem-tgr-constant-linear-energy-causality`; the other four items are `escalated` because the inspected Gibbs–Euler and MC02 supplier readiness is stale or escalated. Their consuming proofs remain explicitly conditional.

The run-wide item-level check still reports 170 errors outside this batch, and the shared batch-dependency record is stale after other manifest changes. Recalculation found no cycle and left batch 56’s level unchanged; the shared record needs owner reconciliation.

The source review uses Bal and Tadmor for the constant-coefficient evolution and finite-speed methods; Gourgoulhon and Romatschke provide fluid and entropy context, while the custom bulk law is proved locally ([Bal](https://www.stat.uchicago.edu/~guillaumebal/COURSES/LecturesWavesRandomMedia.pdf), [Tadmor](https://www.math.umd.edu/~tadmor/lecture-notes/hyperbolic/node6.html), [Gourgoulhon](https://arxiv.org/pdf/gr-qc/0603009), [Romatschke](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0906.4787)).
